# WAF-aligned key rotation example

This scenario evolves the former automatic-key-rotation example. It implements these applicable
recommendations from the [Well-Architected Framework security guidance](https://learn.microsoft.com/azure/well-architected/security/)
and [managed-disk CMK requirements](https://learn.microsoft.com/azure/virtual-machines/disks-enable-customer-managed-keys-portal):

| Concern | Configuration |
| --- | --- |
| Key recovery | Soft delete, purge protection, and 90-day retention on the dependency vault. |
| Key lifecycle | Non-exported RSA-3072 key, wrap/unwrap operations, 180-day expiry, rotation after 90 days, and expiry notification. |
| Encryption continuity | DES automatic rotation, starting from a fully versioned key. |
| Least privilege | System-assigned DES identity receives only Key Vault Crypto Service Encryption User; a separate reader assignment exercises DES-scoped RBAC. |
| Accidental deletion | A `CanNotDelete` lock on the DES. Terraform removes it before teardown. |
| Network access | Key Vault disables public network access and bypasses only trusted Azure services. Key provisioning uses ARM. |
| Auditability | Key Vault audit logs and metrics are sent to a dedicated Log Analytics workspace. |

Dependency resources and location/telemetry controls are separate from module feature inputs.
No private endpoint or application workload is deployed. Workloads requiring private client
access must provide their own private endpoint and DNS configuration. This scenario is not
a claim of complete WAF compliance for arbitrary workloads.

The key is provisioned through a resource-group ARM deployment because the key ARM API
does not support DELETE. Cleanup removes the deployment record and its owning vault;
it does not attempt an unsupported individual key deletion.

```powershell
$env:TF_VAR_location = "westeurope"
avm test e2e --example waf-aligned
```

Use the authorized subscription through Azure authentication. The runner deploys, checks
idempotency, and destroys the example. In addition to resource provisioning and RBAC permissions,
the caller needs subscription-scope deployment permissions when telemetry is enabled.
Log Analytics can incur charges. Purge-protected vaults and keys remain soft-deleted for
90 days after cleanup; unique names avoid collisions on subsequent runs.

```hcl
data "azapi_client_config" "current" {}

resource "random_id" "suffix" {
  byte_length = 6
}

resource "time_static" "key" {}

resource "azapi_resource" "resource_group" {
  location               = var.location
  name                   = "rg-des-waf-${random_id.suffix.hex}"
  parent_id              = data.azapi_client_config.current.subscription_resource_id
  type                   = var.resource_types.resources_resource_groups
  body                   = {}
  ignore_body_changes    = length(var.ignore_body_changes.resources_resource_groups) > 0 ? var.ignore_body_changes.resources_resource_groups : null
  response_export_values = []
  retry                  = var.retry
  tags                   = var.tags

  dynamic "timeouts" {
    for_each = var.timeouts == null ? [] : [var.timeouts]
    content {
      create = timeouts.value.create
      read   = timeouts.value.read
      update = timeouts.value.update
      delete = timeouts.value.delete
    }
  }
}

resource "azapi_resource" "key_vault" {
  location  = var.location
  name      = "kvdes${random_id.suffix.hex}"
  parent_id = azapi_resource.resource_group.id
  type      = var.resource_types.keyvault_vaults
  body = {
    properties = {
      tenantId                  = data.azapi_client_config.current.tenant_id
      sku                       = { family = "A", name = "standard" }
      accessPolicies            = []
      enableRbacAuthorization   = true
      enableSoftDelete          = true
      enablePurgeProtection     = true
      softDeleteRetentionInDays = 90
      publicNetworkAccess       = "Disabled"
      networkAcls = {
        bypass              = "AzureServices"
        defaultAction       = "Deny"
        ipRules             = []
        virtualNetworkRules = []
      }
    }
  }
  ignore_body_changes    = length(var.ignore_body_changes.keyvault_vaults) > 0 ? var.ignore_body_changes.keyvault_vaults : null
  response_export_values = ["properties.vaultUri"]
  retry                  = var.retry
  tags                   = var.tags

  dynamic "timeouts" {
    for_each = var.timeouts == null ? [] : [var.timeouts]
    content {
      create = timeouts.value.create
      read   = timeouts.value.read
      update = timeouts.value.update
      delete = timeouts.value.delete
    }
  }
}

resource "azapi_resource" "key_deployment" {
  name      = "disk-encryption-key"
  parent_id = azapi_resource.resource_group.id
  type      = var.resource_types.resources_deployments
  body = {
    properties = {
      mode = "Incremental"
      template = {
        "$schema"      = "https://schema.management.azure.com/schemas/2019-04-01/deploymentTemplate.json#"
        contentVersion = "1.0.0.0"
        resources = [{
          type       = split("@", var.resource_types.keyvault_vaults_keys)[0]
          apiVersion = split("@", var.resource_types.keyvault_vaults_keys)[1]
          name       = "${azapi_resource.key_vault.name}/disk-encryption"
          tags       = var.tags
          properties = {
            kty     = "RSA"
            keySize = 3072
            keyOps  = ["wrapKey", "unwrapKey"]
            attributes = {
              enabled = true
              exp     = time_static.key.unix + 15552000
            }
            rotationPolicy = {
              attributes = { expiryTime = "P180D" }
              lifetimeActions = [
                {
                  trigger = { timeAfterCreate = "P90D" }
                  action  = { type = "Rotate" }
                },
                {
                  trigger = { timeBeforeExpiry = "P30D" }
                  action  = { type = "Notify" }
                },
              ]
            }
          }
        }]
        outputs = {
          keyUriWithVersion = {
            type  = "string"
            value = "[reference(resourceId('Microsoft.KeyVault/vaults/keys', '${azapi_resource.key_vault.name}', 'disk-encryption'), '${split("@", var.resource_types.keyvault_vaults_keys)[1]}', 'Full').properties.keyUriWithVersion]"
          }
        }
      }
    }
  }
  ignore_body_changes    = length(var.ignore_body_changes.resources_deployments) > 0 ? var.ignore_body_changes.resources_deployments : null
  response_export_values = ["properties.outputs.keyUriWithVersion.value"]
  retry                  = var.retry
  tags                   = var.tags

  dynamic "timeouts" {
    for_each = var.timeouts == null ? [] : [var.timeouts]
    content {
      create = timeouts.value.create
      read   = timeouts.value.read
      update = timeouts.value.update
      delete = timeouts.value.delete
    }
  }
}

resource "azapi_resource" "workspace" {
  location  = var.location
  name      = "law-des-${random_id.suffix.hex}"
  parent_id = azapi_resource.resource_group.id
  type      = var.resource_types.operationalinsights_workspaces
  body = {
    properties = {
      sku             = { name = "PerGB2018" }
      retentionInDays = 30
    }
  }
  ignore_body_changes    = length(var.ignore_body_changes.operationalinsights_workspaces) > 0 ? var.ignore_body_changes.operationalinsights_workspaces : null
  response_export_values = []
  retry                  = var.retry
  tags                   = var.tags

  dynamic "timeouts" {
    for_each = var.timeouts == null ? [] : [var.timeouts]
    content {
      create = timeouts.value.create
      read   = timeouts.value.read
      update = timeouts.value.update
      delete = timeouts.value.delete
    }
  }
}

resource "azapi_resource" "key_vault_diagnostics" {
  name      = "audit"
  parent_id = azapi_resource.key_vault.id
  type      = var.resource_types.insights_diagnostic_settings
  body = {
    properties = {
      workspaceId = azapi_resource.workspace.id
      logs = [
        {
          categoryGroup   = "audit"
          enabled         = true
          retentionPolicy = { days = 0, enabled = false }
        },
        {
          categoryGroup   = "allLogs"
          enabled         = false
          retentionPolicy = { days = 0, enabled = false }
        },
      ]
      metrics = [{ category = "AllMetrics", enabled = true }]
    }
  }
  ignore_body_changes    = length(var.ignore_body_changes.insights_diagnostic_settings) > 0 ? var.ignore_body_changes.insights_diagnostic_settings : null
  response_export_values = []
  retry                  = var.retry

  dynamic "timeouts" {
    for_each = var.timeouts == null ? [] : [var.timeouts]
    content {
      create = timeouts.value.create
      read   = timeouts.value.read
      update = timeouts.value.update
      delete = timeouts.value.delete
    }
  }
}

module "des" {
  source = "../../"

  location                  = var.location
  name                      = "des-${random_id.suffix.hex}"
  parent_id                 = azapi_resource.resource_group.id
  auto_key_rotation_enabled = true
  customer_managed_key = {
    key_vault_resource_id = azapi_resource.key_vault.id
    key_name              = "disk-encryption"
    key_version           = reverse(split("/", azapi_resource.key_deployment.output.properties.outputs.keyUriWithVersion.value))[0]
  }
  enable_telemetry = var.enable_telemetry
  lock = {
    kind = "CanNotDelete"
  }
  managed_identities = {
    system_assigned = true
  }
  role_assignments = {
    reader = {
      role_definition_id_or_name = "/subscriptions/${data.azapi_client_config.current.subscription_id}/providers/Microsoft.Authorization/roleDefinitions/acdd72a7-3385-48ef-bd42-f606fba81ae7"
      principal_id               = data.azapi_client_config.current.object_id
    }
  }
}
```
